breakdown.description: The prompt uses rpm directly as angular velocity in P = T ω, even though ω must be in radians per second.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly instructs to calculate angular velocity using ω = 2π(rpm/60), converting rpm to radians per second before using it in P = T·ω. It also explicitly states to convert power from kW to N·mm/s before calculating torque. The incorrect instruction to substitute rpm directly for ω has been removed, matching the ground truth approach.
